title: File:Frances (Appleton) Longfellow to Emmeline (Austin) Wadsworth, 16 July 1840 (a53b47c9-99c5-4a1a-8242-99f744ae0d7e).jpg
desc:
Manuscript letter
Archives Number: 1011/002.001-010#015
Newport. July 16th 1840. 
My dearest Em, 
As Father is going to-day to leave our cool retreat for a peep at your frying-pan town I make him the bearer of a dispatch to thank you for your 2 nice letters which quite reinstated me in Boston again
